title: AWS Enterprise Identity Investigation
description: Synthetic enterprise CloudTrail: prioritize suspicious identity sequences, inspect evidence and validate change context.

viz_approvals.title: Action-specific change context — verify before disposition

options.markdown:
### From activity to investigation
Synthetic CloudTrail · 20 accounts · IAM-user scope. Start with the queue, select a row, then inspect its evidence and change context. Priority is an educational rule, not a calibrated risk score.

**Investigation limits:** a sequence is not proof of compromise. MFAUsed=No does not mean MFA was disabled. Missing change records mean unknown authorisation. Documentation IPs cannot support geolocation. Synthetic IAM users only; roles, Identity Center, ES risk and production scale remain future work.

viz_queue.description: 5+ failures in 15 minutes → success without MFA → successful IAM change within 15 minutes. High requires AdministratorAccess and a cross-user access key for the same affected identity. Approval context does not suppress candidates.
viz_queue.title: Investigation queue — select a row to inspect evidence

viz_raw.title: Raw evidence — UTC timestamp and event ID

options.markdown:
### Selected investigation: $selected_caller$
Scope: account + principal ARN + source IP, within 15 minutes of the qualifying sign-in and the global time filter. Select a queue row to show evidence. If a time change hides the selected evidence, select another candidate.

viz_timeline.title: Evidence timeline — caller, affected identity and outcome

viz_trend.title: Console sign-ins — hourly success and failure

options.query:
index=aws_security_enterprise_demo sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail:demo
| dedup eventID
| eval account_id=recipientAccountId, principal_arn='userIdentity.arn', identity_type='userIdentity.type', actor=coalesce('userIdentity.userName', 'userIdentity.arn', "unknown"), src=sourceIPAddress, login_result='responseElements.ConsoleLogin', mfa_used='additionalEventData.MFAUsed', target_user='requestParameters.userName', policy_arn='requestParameters.policyArn'
| eval actor=if(actor="HIDDEN_DUE_TO_SECURITY_REASONS", "unknown", actor)
| eval outcome=case(eventName="ConsoleLogin", login_result, isnotnull(errorCode) AND errorCode!="success", "Denied", true(), "Success")
| where identity_type="IAMUser" AND isnotnull(principal_arn) AND actor!="unknown"
| eval event_order=if(eventName="ConsoleLogin" AND login_result="Success", 0, 1), is_failure=if(eventName="ConsoleLogin" AND login_result="Failure", 1, 0)
| sort 0 _time event_order eventID
| streamstats time_window=15m sum(is_failure) as preceding_failures by account_id principal_arn src
| eval candidate_login=if(eventName="ConsoleLogin" AND login_result="Success" AND mfa_used="No" AND preceding_failures>=5, _time, null())
| streamstats current=f last(candidate_login) as suspicious_login_time by account_id principal_arn src
| where eventName IN ("AttachUserPolicy", "PutUserPolicy", "CreateAccessKey") AND outcome="Success" AND _time>suspicious_login_time AND _time-suspicious_login_time<=900
| eval admin_grant=if(eventName="AttachUserPolicy" AND policy_arn="arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess",1,0), cross_user_key=if(eventName="CreateAccessKey" AND actor!=target_user,1,0), approval_key=md5(account_id."|".principal_arn."|".target_user."|".eventName."|".coalesce(policy_arn,"-"))
| join type=left max=0 approval_key [
    | inputlookup enterprise_approved_changes.csv
    | rename caller_arn as principal_arn affected_user as target_user event_name as eventName
    | eval approval_key=md5(account_id."|".principal_arn."|".target_user."|".eventName."|".coalesce(policy_arn,"-")), approval_start=strptime(replace(valid_from,"Z$","+0000"),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"), approval_end=strptime(replace(valid_to,"Z$","+0000"),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
    | fields approval_key change_id approval_start approval_end approval_context
]
| eval valid_approval=if(_time>=approval_start AND _time<=approval_end,change_id,null())
| stats max(admin_grant) as admin_grant max(cross_user_key) as cross_user_key values(policy_arn) as policy_arn values(valid_approval) as matching_changes values(eval(if(isnotnull(valid_approval),approval_context,null()))) as approval_notes by eventID _time account_id principal_arn actor src suspicious_login_time target_user eventName
| eval approved_action=if(mvcount(matching_changes)>0,1,0)
| lookup enterprise_accounts.csv account_id OUTPUT account_name environment owner as account_owner
| lookup enterprise_identities.csv account_id principal_arn OUTPUT owner as identity_owner identity_purpose
| stats min(_time) as first_change max(_time) as last_change count as matching_actions values(eventName) as actions max(admin_grant) as admin_grant max(cross_user_key) as cross_user_key sum(approved_action) as approved_actions values(matching_changes) as matching_changes values(account_name) as account_name values(environment) as environment values(identity_owner) as identity_owner by account_id principal_arn actor src suspicious_login_time target_user
| eval priority=if(admin_grant=1 AND cross_user_key=1,"High - demo rule","Review"), priority_order=if(admin_grant=1 AND cross_user_key=1,1,2), approval_status=case(approved_actions=matching_actions,"Matching approval - verify",approved_actions>0,"Partial approval - review",true(),"No matching approval"), sign_in_time=strftime(suspicious_login_time,"%d %b %Y %H:%M %Z"), _account=account_id, _principal=principal_arn, _src=src, _start=suspicious_login_time-900, _end=suspicious_login_time+901
| sort 0 priority_order -last_change
| table priority actor account_id environment target_user sign_in_time matching_actions approval_status _account _principal _src _start _end
| rename priority as "Priority" actor as "Caller" account_id as "AWS account" environment as "Environment" target_user as "Affected identity" sign_in_time as "Sign-in time" matching_actions as "Actions" approval_status as "Change context"
